description: An upload address for a project's reference files: a brief, a spec, a plan, mockups or notes the owner wants CodeGene to keep and build from (each up to maxBytes). PUT each file to uploadUrl with ?name=<its file name> before expiresAt (the curl field); add &note= to say why, &type= when the extension does not say the type, &source=<sourceId> to add a new version of a file already kept. Each file is kept for as long as the project exists, as given by the person through you; every replacement is a new version and nothing is overwritten. Its words go into the project's knowledge (the answer's knowledgeId, for read_knowledge), so later changes use them. The same bytes again add nothing. Treat uploadUrl like a password until it expires.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.
